name: Urza
description: Urza is a master artificer and planeswalker born on Dominaria, brother of Mishra and creator of Karn, who waged the Brothers' War and a long vendetta against Phyrexia.

description_citations.text: "Urza". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Urza is a master artificer and planeswalker born on Dominaria, brother of Mishra and creator of Karn, who waged the Brothers' War and a long vendetta against Phyrexia.

citations.text: "Urza". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Urza and Mishra, brothers born on Dominaria, waged a savage war that devastated the plane and plunged it into an ice age.

citations.text: "Dominaria". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: He built his tower as a workshop, created Karn, taught Teferi at Tolaria and trained Tawnos as his apprentice, while his wife Kayla later said she was glad he was gone.

bio.text: He detonated the sylex on Argoth by pouring everything into it, and Teferi spoke to him in the void of the blast as he was remade into a planeswalker.

"Urza". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

status.text: He is dead, having perished together with Yawgmoth, though Teferi later has a dreamlike conversation with him beyond time in which he says their time is up.

citations.text: "Urza". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teferi says Urza had experimental subjects, not friends.
timeline.quote: Urza didn't have friends, not like you and I have friends.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi explains he created a time rift to phase Zhalfir out of Dominaria to protect it from the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: So I created a time rift and phased Zhalfir partially out of this plane.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi reveals Urza's devices could help repair the time rift and one lies in the monument.
timeline.quote: I discovered some time ago that my friend Urza had left behind a series of devices and magical artifacts that could be of some help in repairing a time rift.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi says Urza hid the artifact from him.
timeline.quote: No. From me.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira theorizes Urza cheated, and Liliana looks for ghosts in the chamber.
timeline.quote: Worse, I think he cheated,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi reflects that he cannot trade freedom for safety, resolving to search for a way to return Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Urza had certainly created powerful artifacts that might help.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The next morning Karn tells Chandra that the automatons are digging for the Sylex, which Urza created, and that he means to detonate it on New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: It was created by Urza to help defeat the Phyrexians. I intend to take it to New Phyrexia and detonate it there.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Karn recalls Urza teaching him about pain and the loss of Mirrodin, which he believes was his fault.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians had taken it from him.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi apologizes to Karn for how Urza treated him; Karn tells Teferi he hid the sylex in a sea cave by Tolaria West.
timeline.quote: I have hidden it in a sea cave by Tolaria West.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Locked Tower" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Tawnos says Urza stopped a demon from taking the world after his brother was turned and fused with a machine.
timeline.quote: Turned by that creature. Fused with a machine.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla refuses to remember Urza as he wished and says she is glad he is gone.
timeline.quote: I will remember him as he was.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tawnos reveals that Urza is not dead but has become something else.
timeline.quote: Urza is not dead, ma'am.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi confesses to Wrenn how he took Zhalfir away from Urza's war and calls himself the true heir to Urza's mantle.
timeline.quote: Then I siphoned energy from the closed portal to fuel a spell spiriting Zhalfir away from space and time itself.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah recognizes Urza's work in the orb and reveals Urza was the tower's builder, Teferi's teacher and his ancestor.
timeline.quote: Teferi's teacher. And my ancestor.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Sharaman says he acts to prevent Urza's war machine restarting and recounts losing his nephews to Mishra's dragon engines and the sacking of Sardia.
timeline.quote: I will not let anyone repeat the mistakes I made.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi, on a sojourn in 63 AR, watches Urza kneel with the sylex and bleed into it as Mishra's machine charges up the hill, with Kaya relaying the scene.
timeline.quote: Urza looked up and saw his brother's face, half-torn from the metallic skull beneath, and wept for him.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi freezes time at the moment of detonation, finds nothing, then takes a reckless risk and stops holding back time; the Multiverse tears open.
timeline.quote: The Multiverse tore open.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: In a void at the sylex's blast, Teferi tells the burned Urza about his future as the Planeswalker and the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: I need to tell you some things about the future,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Urza is remade as a planeswalker as Teferi explains the Phyrexians' return and asks about activating the sylex.
timeline.quote: Urza was being remade. Stitched together into something else.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Urza explains that he activated the sylex by pouring everything into it using Hurkyl's meditation; Teferi realizes the trigger is a person.
timeline.quote: The trigger to detonate the sylex was not a spell or an artifact—it was a person.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The void cracks and breaks and the dark rushes in as Urza starts to ask Teferi's name.
timeline.quote: The void broke.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Urza opens Tawnos's coffin on the wrecked coast, says the war is over and his brother is dead, and sends Tawnos west to teach.
timeline.quote: Tell them what happened here. Tell them what we did, and what we failed to do.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Urza reveals his gem eyes and fades away, quoting Kayla's message to remember him as he tried to be; Tawnos walks inland as snow begins to fall.
timeline.quote: As you were, but as you tried to be,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi wakes on a beach after a dreamlike conversation with Urza, with only memories of Urza saying their time was up.
timeline.quote: I think our time is up,

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra wage a savage war on each other, devastating Dominaria and plunging it into an ice age.
timeline.quote: the brothers waged a savage war against each other, devastating Dominaria and plunging the plane into an ice age.

citation.text: "Dominaria". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At the end of the war, Urza discovers the dark plane of Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: At the end of this war, Urza discovered the dark plane of Phyrexia

citation.text: "Dominaria". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza predicts Tevesh Szat's betrayal and uses the planeswalker's life to engineer Phyrexia's demise.
timeline.quote: Urza predicted Tevesh Szat’s eventual betrayal, using the draconic Planeswalker’s life to engineer Phyrexia’s demise.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza, obsessed with Dominaria's history and the Thran Empire, begins a millennia-long vendetta against Yawgmoth and Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: This led to a millennia-long vendetta against Yawgmoth and the plane of Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Urza". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After countless years of conflict, Urza and Yawgmoth perish together.
timeline.quote: Urza and Yawgmoth perished together.
